description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF13 allies are alive, grants [Synchro Mode], [Chirpy Pilot Mode] and Paternal Instinct +1 to the user

description.name: Breaking Shot
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.90 each), grants [PHY +30% Boost 1] to all allies if 4+ XIII allies are alive

description.name: Triple Grit
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.90 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +15% (8s)] to all allies if the user has Paternal Instinct level 1, causes Paternal Instinct -1 to the user

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Chirpy Pilot Mode
description.text: Casts Debilitating Shot after another ally casts an elemental ability, removed after triggering six times

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
